user: I want to open a new account
bot: You can open a new account by visiting our nearest branch with valid ID proof and address proof. Our team will guide you through the process.

user: How do I check my account balance
bot: You can check your account balance through our mobile app internet banking or by visiting an ATM. You can also call our customer service.

user: I lost my debit card
bot: Please report your lost debit card immediately by calling our 24/7 helpline. We will block your card and issue a new one within 3-5 business days.

user: What are the loan interest rates
bot: Our loan interest rates vary based on the type of loan. Personal loans start from 10.5% and home loans from 8.5%. Please visit our branch for detailed information.

user: How can I update my KYC details
bot: You can update your KYC details by visiting our branch with updated documents or through our online portal with digital document upload.

user: What is the minimum balance required
bot: The minimum balance requirement varies by account type. Savings accounts require Rs.1000 and current accounts require Rs.5000 minimum balance.

user: How do I apply for a credit card
bot: You can apply for a credit card online through our website or mobile app. You can also visit our branch with income proof and ID documents.

user: What are your branch timings
bot: Our branches are open Monday to Friday from 10 AM to 4 PM and Saturday from 10 AM to 2 PM. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.

user: How do I transfer money online
bot: You can transfer money through our internet banking or mobile app using NEFT RTGS or IMPS. You need to add beneficiary details first.

user: What is the FD interest rate
bot: Our Fixed Deposit interest rates range from 5.5% to 7.2% depending on the tenure and amount. Senior citizens get additional 0.5% interest.

user: I want to close my account
bot: To close your account please visit our branch with your passbook debit card and ID proof. Clear all pending dues before account closure.

user: How do I activate internet banking
bot: You can activate internet banking by visiting our branch or through our mobile app. You will need your account number and registered mobile number.

user: What documents are needed for loan
bot: For loans you need income proof ID proof address proof bank statements and property documents for secured loans.

user: How do I report fraudulent transaction
bot: Report fraudulent transactions immediately by calling our fraud helpline. We will investigate and reverse unauthorized transactions if verified.

user: What are the charges for ATM withdrawal
bot: ATM withdrawals are free for first 5 transactions per month. Beyond that Rs.20 is charged for same bank ATMs and Rs.25 for other bank ATMs.

user: How can I get a loan statement
bot: You can download loan statements from internet banking mobile app or request them at our branch. Email delivery is also available.

user: What is the process for home loan
bot: For home loans submit application with documents. After verification and property evaluation we will approve and disburse the loan amount.

user: How do I change my mobile number
bot: To change your registered mobile number visit our branch with ID proof and fill the mobile number change form.

user: What are the tax benefits on FD
bot: Fixed Deposits under Rs.1.5 lakhs qualify for tax deduction under Section 80C. Tax is deducted on interest earned above Rs.10000.

user: How do I get a duplicate passbook
bot: For duplicate passbook visit our branch with ID proof and pay the applicable charges. New passbook will be issued immediately.
